note: Expected streams written 2026-10-14 BEFORE any encoder was run. Catalog = raw streams of artifacts/agere-healthcare-v28-sample-0.30/stack/source-profile.json (237 streams). A case is a hit at k when ANY accepted stream ranks in the top k. The first 5 cases are the coordinator's; the rest cover the remaining healthcare domains. There is no prior-authorization stream in this release (billing_authorizations is self-pay cash authorization): the prior-auth question is answered by referrals.authorization_required.
